name: SHIV
_comment: Shiv's shotgun from Deadlock onto the SHOTGUN gestalt (first weapon on this host). Non-distributable: the model, textures and sounds are Valve's; the glb (scratch/dl_shiv/shiv_gun.glb) and everything derived from it stay out of the repo. The glb is prepared by scratch/dl_shiv/work/export_glb.py from Source2Viewer-CLI's shiv.vmdl_c export: the static 'gun' mesh only, rotated into the add-on frame (muzzle -Y, up +Z) and scaled inches->cm (x2.54), groups root/trigger/lever carried as skin weights; the muzzle is the barrel's front ring (both bores, so the centre between them). A bone-parented 'muzzle' empty exported from Blender landed 9 units off (the bone-tail trap), so it is not used. Shotgun fragment table from the OpenBLCMM dump per docs/history/M9_NOTES.md section 1 (scratch/gestalt_SG_fragments.txt, 45 rows, no repeats).

placement._note: trigger -> Trigger. 1.3 (first build) filled a third of the screen and read blocky; 0.9 is a little under Deadlock's own proportions (83 cm at 1.0). 1.72 would reach the stock Jakobs muzzle socket.

bones._note: only the trigger moves. The lever loop stays on Root: no lever bone on the shotgun host, and Pump/Barrel/Slider are unprobed (M9 rule: never bind a bone whose clip is unknown).

_order_note: fragments[] is the EXPORT order (it fixes each fragment's index range in the package and so the spec's first_index); rule_order is the order the face rules are tried in, first match wins, the remainder is the body
_rules_note: face rules are in PLACED coordinates (after scale + anchor), so a scale change moves every cut: these are the 1.3 build's planes re-expressed at 0.9 (source y -28.65 / z -12.13, y -13.27 / y 7.50)
